description: This PHP source file defines the OriginListener class within the Goteo application, responsible for tracking and recording the referer and user agent information during HTTP requests and responses, as well as handling origin data for investments. It subscribes to kernel events and custom application events to perform its functions.

classes.name: OriginListener
classes.description: A listener class that tracks the HTTP referer and user agent to record origin statistics, manages session data related to origin, and updates origin records based on request and response events, including investment-related origin data.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles the kernel request event; captures user agent and referer info from the request and stores it in session, avoiding sub-requests and invalid or internal referers.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Handles the kernel response event; registers the origin info (UA and referer) for projects, calls, and channels based on the session data, saving origin records if they've changed.

methods.name: onInvestInit
methods.description: Handles the custom INVEST_INIT event to record the origin of an investment, storing UA and referer info associated with the investment ID.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel and application events to the class methods that handle them.
